facts.fact: Mangaung Metropolitan Municipality told the NCOP it had appointed a service provider to upgrade its network infrastructure across the seven towns under the metro, with the first phase under way, and that its own appointment of an internet service provider for last-mile connectivity and VoIP was still in progress.
facts.system: Mangaung network infrastructure upgrade and last-mile connectivity (converged infrastructure: broadband and VoIP)

facts.fact: Mangaung Metro reports that it moved its email to a cloud-based platform and its authentication to cloud-based Entra ID, with 900 on-premises user accounts migrated in addition to 600 already in the cloud, and moved some services from the city's data centre to an Azure private cloud.
facts.system: Mangaung network infrastructure upgrade and last-mile connectivity (converged infrastructure: broadband and VoIP)

facts.fact: The network upgrade and the internet service provider appointment are the metro's own projects, run under its council-approved ICT governance framework with an ICT Steering Committee and the City Manager as governance champion.
facts.system: Mangaung network infrastructure upgrade and last-mile connectivity (converged infrastructure: broadband and VoIP)

facts.fact: Mangaung Metro reports an adopted three-year ICT Strategic Plan and Implementation Roadmap whose technology focus area names converged infrastructure, broadband and VoIP, as an outcome; the plan is the metro's own and covers no other municipality.
facts.system: Mangaung network infrastructure upgrade and last-mile connectivity (converged infrastructure: broadband and VoIP)

facts.fact: The metro names no source of funds for the network upgrade and twice says it faces limited resources and an inadequate budget for ICT.
facts.system: Mangaung network infrastructure upgrade and last-mile connectivity (converged infrastructure: broadband and VoIP)

facts.fact: By the NCOP provincial week of 17 to 21 November 2025 Mangaung Metro had recently appointed a service provider for a network infrastructure upgrade in its seven towns and begun the first phase, with the internet service provider for last-mile connectivity still to be appointed.
facts.system: Mangaung network infrastructure upgrade and last-mile connectivity (converged infrastructure: broadband and VoIP)

facts.fact: The report covers one metropolitan municipality, Mangaung, and its seven towns, on the metro's own account; it gives no figure for municipalities nationally.
facts.system: Mangaung network infrastructure upgrade and last-mile connectivity (converged infrastructure: broadband and VoIP)
